title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements

title: Regional Lead - Amazon
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional Lead - Amazon em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB OVERVIEW

Are you a dynamic leader with diverse skillsets who has experience in nonprofit program management and/or economic development? Empowered by Light is seeking a Regional Lead - Amazon to help us implement, strengthen and expand our work supporting indigenous communities in the Amazon Basin. If you are a self-starter, are passionate about environmental justice, and have experience developing and managing nonprofit and/or economic development programs, we’d love to meet you.


ABOUT US

Empowered by Light is a United States 501(c)3 nonprofit organization transforming life through renewable energy systems. We have completed more than 130 projects in 10 countries helping improve lives while enabling communities to leapfrog or displace fossil fuels. Our projects provide energy access, displace diesel, improve education, health, safety and opportunity, strengthen conservation, and help communities become more resilient and sustainable.


JOB DETAILS

  • Job Type:   Contractor position with a deliverables-focused contract expected to require approximately 80 hours per month on average.
  • Workplace Policy: Remote (no formal office space/use required). Contractor has autonomy over how and when work is performed provided deliverables are met.
  • Location: Manaus, preferred but not required.
  • Schedule: Work is expected to require approximately 80/month on average.  
  • Travel: Approximately 25% depending on your location.
  • Compensation: Contract rates are benchmarked against local market standards for independent consultants/contractors. The final rate offered will be based on the contractor’s primary location, level of experience, specialized expertise, and complexity of the deliverables.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years experience in nonprofit, economic development and/or aid program management, renewable energy, or a related field.
  • College Degree (Associates or Bachelors) or significant work experience. 
  • Demonstrated experience implementing aid or economic development programs and developing community partnerships.
  • High level of cultural sensitivity.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and Conversational to Fluent in English.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Familiarity with Google Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides).
  • Some solar technical knowledge preferred but not required.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Background in renewable energy (technology, policy, or personal interest).


RESPONSIBILITIES


Program Management

  • Help manage and expand Empowered by Light’s Amazon program.
  • With support from local and HQ staff, build and maintain strong relationships with community-based organizations, local governments, local partners and local NGOs.
  • Help identify, assess and ensure the sustainability of high-impact projects that maximize benefits for a community while making efficient use of organizational resources.
  • Generate and implement ideas for systems, programs, and operational improvement.
  • Generate and implement ideas for systems, programs, and operational improvement.
  • Oversee local project implementation from start to finish.
  • Fill gaps: support EBL staff on administrative and organizational tasks as needed.


Renewable Tech Deployment

  • Coordinate site surveys by solar installers and help identify, assess and prioritize projects in the region.
  • Coordinate logistics and serve as liaison between local communities and solar installers.
  • Coordinate and oversee site inspections and quality control.


Training & Capacity Building

  • With support from Empowered by Light HQ staff, help develop and organize workshops and community trainings for renewable energy system maintenance and operations.
  • Integrate local labor and workforce development partners into project activities where applicable.


Reporting & Compliance

  • With support from Empowered by Light HQ staff, track and report on deployments, user agreements, usage metrics, and community impacts.
  • Provide administrative data entry and maintenance of projects, contacts, and more.
  • Provide monthly reports and quarterly evaluations in line with grant or other requirements.


DELIVERABLES

  • Significant expansion of existing network of local partner organizations. 
  • Defined planned for securing and reporting impact metrics from all projects in the region installed by EBL to date.
  • Development of impact strategy for the Amazon Basin across 3-4 countries.
  • Research and development of potential income-generating initiatives for communities to improve sustainability. 
  • Collection of media collateral across all projects/regions (e.g., photos, testimonials, etc.)


ATTRIBUTES

  • Excited to support a small, nimble, and impactful organization. 
  • Adaptable. You can pivot and problem-solve under pressure.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills. You’re patient and respectful while assisting people of all skill levels and comfortable working with diverse groups of people.
  • Ask questions to clarify tasks and priorities. You feel comfortable saying, “I don’t know” or “I need help with this.”
  • Self-starter. You are able to work independently and remotely without needing handholding.
  • On board with advancing renewable energy technology, decarbonizing our planet, and working towards a just, equitable energy transition. You share our values.


APPLICATION PROCESS

Please send your resume with a cover letter and references to . 


No one candidate will fit all the requirements, so everyone who fits at least some of the skills and has a willingness to learn is encouraged to apply.

title: Regional Lead - Amazon
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional Lead - Amazon em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB OVERVIEW

Are you a dynamic leader with diverse skillsets who has experience in nonprofit program management and/or economic development? Empowered by Light is seeking a Regional Lead - Amazon to help us implement, strengthen and expand our work supporting indigenous communities in the Amazon Basin. If you are a self-starter, are passionate about environmental justice, and have experience developing and managing nonprofit and/or economic development programs, we’d love to meet you.


ABOUT US

Empowered by Light is a United States 501(c)3 nonprofit organization transforming life through renewable energy systems. We have completed more than 130 projects in 10 countries helping improve lives while enabling communities to leapfrog or displace fossil fuels. Our projects provide energy access, displace diesel, improve education, health, safety and opportunity, strengthen conservation, and help communities become more resilient and sustainable.


JOB DETAILS

  • Job Type:   Contractor position with a deliverables-focused contract expected to require approximately 80 hours per month on average.
  • Workplace Policy: Remote (no formal office space/use required). Contractor has autonomy over how and when work is performed provided deliverables are met.
  • Location: Manaus, preferred but not required.
  • Schedule: Work is expected to require approximately 80/month on average.  
  • Travel: Approximately 25% depending on your location.
  • Compensation: Contract rates are benchmarked against local market standards for independent consultants/contractors. The final rate offered will be based on the contractor’s primary location, level of experience, specialized expertise, and complexity of the deliverables.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years experience in nonprofit, economic development and/or aid program management, renewable energy, or a related field.
  • College Degree (Associates or Bachelors) or significant work experience. 
  • Demonstrated experience implementing aid or economic development programs and developing community partnerships.
  • High level of cultural sensitivity.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and Conversational to Fluent in English.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Familiarity with Google Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides).
  • Some solar technical knowledge preferred but not required.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Background in renewable energy (technology, policy, or personal interest).


RESPONSIBILITIES


Program Management

  • Help manage and expand Empowered by Light’s Amazon program.
  • With support from local and HQ staff, build and maintain strong relationships with community-based organizations, local governments, local partners and local NGOs.
  • Help identify, assess and ensure the sustainability of high-impact projects that maximize benefits for a community while making efficient use of organizational resources.
  • Generate and implement ideas for systems, programs, and operational improvement.
  • Generate and implement ideas for systems, programs, and operational improvement.
  • Oversee local project implementation from start to finish.
  • Fill gaps: support EBL staff on administrative and organizational tasks as needed.


Renewable Tech Deployment

  • Coordinate site surveys by solar installers and help identify, assess and prioritize projects in the region.
  • Coordinate logistics and serve as liaison between local communities and solar installers.
  • Coordinate and oversee site inspections and quality control.


Training & Capacity Building

  • With support from Empowered by Light HQ staff, help develop and organize workshops and community trainings for renewable energy system maintenance and operations.
  • Integrate local labor and workforce development partners into project activities where applicable.


Reporting & Compliance

  • With support from Empowered by Light HQ staff, track and report on deployments, user agreements, usage metrics, and community impacts.
  • Provide administrative data entry and maintenance of projects, contacts, and more.
  • Provide monthly reports and quarterly evaluations in line with grant or other requirements.


DELIVERABLES

  • Significant expansion of existing network of local partner organizations. 
  • Defined planned for securing and reporting impact metrics from all projects in the region installed by EBL to date.
  • Development of impact strategy for the Amazon Basin across 3-4 countries.
  • Research and development of potential income-generating initiatives for communities to improve sustainability. 
  • Collection of media collateral across all projects/regions (e.g., photos, testimonials, etc.)


ATTRIBUTES

  • Excited to support a small, nimble, and impactful organization. 
  • Adaptable. You can pivot and problem-solve under pressure.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills. You’re patient and respectful while assisting people of all skill levels and comfortable working with diverse groups of people.
  • Ask questions to clarify tasks and priorities. You feel comfortable saying, “I don’t know” or “I need help with this.”
  • Self-starter. You are able to work independently and remotely without needing handholding.
  • On board with advancing renewable energy technology, decarbonizing our planet, and working towards a just, equitable energy transition. You share our values.


APPLICATION PROCESS

Please send your resume with a cover letter and references to . 


No one candidate will fit all the requirements, so everyone who fits at least some of the skills and has a willingness to learn is encouraged to apply.


Empowered by Light is an organization that promotes equal opportunity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age, religion, nationality, disability, health condition, or any other characteristic protected by Brazilian law (Federal Constitution and Law No. 9.029/1995)

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance, Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business.
  • Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations.
  • Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required.
  • Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities.
  • Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions.
  • Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management.
  • Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets.
  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred.
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous.
  • Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial.
  • Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.).
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa).
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations.
  • Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
  • Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency.
  • Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS).
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.
  • Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus.
  • Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media 🚀


We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!


Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Planejador Financeiro/ Patrimonial e Investimentos (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro/ Patrimonial e Investimentos (Pessoa Física) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

description:

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.

This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership.


Key Responsibilities:


Advanced English


• Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers.


• Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks.


• Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements.

Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus)


• Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT.


• Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks.


• Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups.


SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:


o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based)


o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views


o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains


Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:


o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures

o CDS Views (where applicable)

• Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance.


• Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy.


Reporting & Analytics:


Oversee reporting solutions using:


o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable)


• Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain).


Migration & Modernization:


Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including:


o Readiness checks and simplification item handling


o Remediation of custom code and data models


o Data volume management and performance validation


• Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective.

Production Support & Governance

• Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution.

• Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation.


Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

description:

We are looking for an experienced Functional Business Consultant (with Infor WMS experience) to support us with WMS Integration and Implementation projects, Audits and Consulting projects.


Innovecs is a global digital transformation tech company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Software & Hightech, and Gaming.

For the fifth year in a row, Innovecs is included in the Inc. 5000 and recognized in IAOP’s ranking of the best global outsourcing service providers. Innovecs is featured in the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces Ranking and won gold at the Employer Brand Management Awards.

  • Hands-on experience with Infor WMS (must);

  • Understanding of warehouse processes including receiving, putaway, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and inventory management;
  • Experience onboarding customers and supporting production environments;
  • Experience performing WMS system configuration and minor functional enhancements;
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills;
  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into system configuration changes;
  • Experience creating and maintaining functional documentation and training materials;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with warehouse operators, customer stakeholders, and technical teams;
  • Working knowledge of SQL is a plus;
  • Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) is a strong plus;
  • Understanding of 3PL operational processes and customer implementations is a strong plus;
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and customer-oriented mindset;
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced support environment;
  • Advanced or native English .



Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary functional support contact for Infor WMS customers;
  • Support onboarding and implementation of new customers onto the WMS platform;
  • Conduct customer discovery sessions to understand operational requirements and warehouse processes;
  • Configure WMS settings and perform minor system adjustments based on approved business requirements;
  • Troubleshoot functional issues, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with technical teams when required;
  • Perform gap analysis between customer requirements and existing WMS functionality;
  • Create and maintain configuration documentation, process flows, user guides, and support materials;
  • Assist with testing activities, including system validation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT);
  • Deliver end-user and operational training for warehouse personnel and customer teams;
  • Support customer go-live activities and provide post-implementation hypercare support;
  • Monitor support tickets, prioritise customer issues, and ensure timely resolution;
  • Work closely with operations, implementation, and development teams to improve system performance and customer experience;
  • Recommend process improvements and optimisation opportunities within warehouse operations and WMS configuration;
  • Maintain strong understanding of Infor WMS best practices and emerging Supply Chain technology trends;
  • Act as a subject matter expert for Infor WMS configuration and warehouse operational workflows.


  • Nice-to-have: Experience with TMS integrations, EDI processes, 3PL multi-customer warehouse environments, and warehouse automation solutions.

title: Remote QA Specialist - Audio Annotation & Diarization (Japanese)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote QA Specialist - Audio Annotation & Diarization (Japanese) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are building a highly accurate, evaluation-grade dataset of transcribed, multi-channel audio recordings to assess multilingual, multi-speaker AI systems. This project involves evaluating high-quality and realistic conversations representing diverse dynamics, contexts, and demographics.


The Workflow:

Contributors record unscripted group conversations. These recordings are run through an initial transcription and diarization pass, which contributors then human-validate and correct. As a QA Specialist, you are the final line of defense, responsible for reviewing the end-to-end quality of both the audio recordings and the human-verified annotations.


Key Responsibilities

Audio Quality Assurance:

  • Evaluate multi-channel audio recordings to ensure they meet strict technical and fidelity requirements.
  • Verify channel isolation (ensuring no audio bleed) and confirm that recordings were captured in appropriate, quiet environments free from disruptive background noise, clipping, or low gain.


Transcription & Diarization Verification:

  • Review human-validated transcriptions to guarantee exceptionally high accuracy and adherence to strict low error-rate (WER) targets.
  • Confirm that transcripts correctly capture spontaneous, unnormalized speech, preserving natural conversational dynamics such as overlaps, interruptions, and false starts.
  • Validate the precision of turn-level and word-level timestamps, as well as speaker identification, paying special attention to complex, overlapping dialogue , while comfortably reading and validating the underlying JSON-formatted data to ensure accurate metadata tagging and timestamp logic.


Metadata & Content Review:

  • Verify the accuracy of all applied metadata, including demographic markers, contextual domains, and specific conversational tags.
  • Enforce strict safety and privacy standards by auditing sessions to ensure no Personally Identifying Information (PII), toxic, or sensitive content is present.
  • Execution & Reporting:
  • Assess the end-to-end quality of the annotation task, assigning clear pass/fail or agree/disagree statuses during your review.
  • Provide detailed, actionable comments and feedback whenever disagreeing with an annotator's work.


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Exceptional ear for audio fidelity and the ability to detect subtle background noises, channel bleed, or clipping.
  • Meticulous attention to detail for verifying word-level timestamps and strict, unnormalized verbatim transcription rules.
  • Native proficiency in Japanese
  • Ability to accurately assess complex multi-speaker dynamics.


Ideal Backgrounds include:

  • Linguists/Phonetics Experts: Deep understanding of natural, unnormalized speech patterns. Expertise in accurately identifying and annotating complex conversational dynamics, including overlaps, false starts, and backchannels.
  • Language Teachers: Exceptional, native-level mastery of the target language. Ability to strictly adhere to verbatim transcription guidelines, documenting every stutter, filler word, and disfluency without applying prescriptive grammar corrections.
  • Professional Transcriptionists: Ear for audio fidelity , rigorous timestamping skills, and experience meeting strict accuracy targets. Rigorous approach to precise turn-level and word-level timestamping.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks


Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.

description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA EDUCADOR FÍSICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Educador Físico! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar atendimentos por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Educador Físico , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Realizar orientação esportiva por vídeo e telefone com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo acolhedor, empático e resolutivo na maioria das orientações de acordo com os objetivos e dúvidas de saúde trazidos pelos beneficiários, respeitando os diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários;
  • Contatar os beneficiários através de orientações telefônicas e/ou chamada de vídeo para aplicação de anamnese esportiva, com o objetivo de identificar a familiaridade do beneficiário com a atividade física e suas limitações/ restrições de saúde bem como necessidades de melhorias nos hábitos esportivos, para realizar um treino focado e personalizado a cada indivíduo, considerando sua condição clínica, hábitos, comportamentos e objetivo do beneficiário;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas esportivas pontuais, conforme demanda trazida pelo beneficiário garantindo a sua satisfação;
  • Elaborar treinos esportivos personalizados, conforme necessidade e objetivo de cada beneficiário e posterior envio ao mesmo através de e-mail, dentro do prazo estipulado para que melhorem a sua saúde e desta forma atinjam os melhores resultados do programa;
  • Realizar acompanhamento esportivo periódico, para checar se o objetivo esperado está sendo atingido e avaliar se há necessidade de desenvolver novo material;
  • Enviar e-mail e/ou sms, whatsapp para verificar a disponibilidade de horário dos beneficiários, com o objetivo de maior assertividade nas ligações e gerar maior adesão ao programa;
  • Ter visão clínica ampla para saber quando e como solicitar suporte junto a equipe multiprofissional (nutricionista, médico e enfermagem), visando o atendimento das necessidades do beneficiário;
  • Registrar todas as orientações e informações (prestadas e coletadas) aos beneficiários e colaboradores da Teladoc Health em sistema eletrônico e/ou planilha de Excel, visando manter atualizada as bases e tratando de forma confidencial, tornando os processos seguros, éticos e legais;
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática centrada na pessoa;
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes;
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética da Educação Esportiva, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: SUPERIOR COMPLETO EM EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA


EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Vivência em montagem de treinos e atuação como Personal Trainer.


CONHECIMENTO ESPECÍFICOS PARA A FUNÇÃO

  • Conhecimentos e Habilidades no Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point).
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Capacidade investigativa;
  • Raciocínio clínico.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


*Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CREF do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Innovecs is a global digital transformation tech company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Software & Hightech, and Gaming.

For the fifth year in a row, Innovecs is included in the Inc. 5000 and recognized in IAOP’s ranking of the best global outsourcing service providers. Innovecs is featured in the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces Ranking and won gold at the Employer Brand Management Awards.

  • Hands-on experience with Infor WMS (must);
  • Experience in Supply Chain , Warehousing, Logistics, or 3PL operations (must);
  • Understanding of warehouse processes including receiving, putaway, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and inventory management;

  • Experience performing WMS system configuration and minor functional enhancements;

  • Experience creating and maintaining functional documentation and training materials;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with warehouse operators, customer stakeholders, and technical teams;

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Graphic Designer & AI Specialist  - TB0609
description:

Job Description: Graphic Designer & AI Specialist - TB0609

Location: Remote-LATAM

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: 1200 $ per month

Contract Type: This is an Independent Contractor role, managed through Remote Hero for dedicated work with the client.

Working Hours: Full-Time (40 hours/week) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CEST Central European Summer Time (Gibraltar) — Must be fully available on CEST hours for real-time team feedback.


About the Client:

Our client is a dynamic and established creative agency, delivering high-impact design and communications solutions across a range of industries. Known for their collaborative culture and commitment to creative excellence, they work with diverse clients to bring bold ideas to life through compelling visual storytelling.


About the Role:

We are seeking a highly creative and tech-savvy Graphic Designer & AI Creative Specialist to join our growing team. This role is equally focused on professional graphic design execution and AI-powered content creation, making it ideal for someone who combines strong visual design skills with a passion for leveraging AI to enhance creativity and productivity.

You will be responsible for creating high-quality visual assets across multiple channels, including social media, newsletters, presentations, marketing collateral, brochures, and branded materials. Using both traditional design tools and advanced AI platforms, you'll transform ideas into polished, professional content that aligns with brand standards and marketing objectives.

The ideal candidate understands that AI is not a replacement for design expertise—it is a tool that accelerates creativity. You know how to generate, refine, expand, and elevate AI-generated content into premium-quality deliverables ready for publication and client use.

🚀 Key Responsibilities:

Graphic Design & Brand Development

- Design high-quality visual assets for digital and print channels, including:

- Social media graphics and campaigns

- Marketing materials and advertisements

- Newsletters and email marketing layouts

- Corporate presentations and pitch decks

- Brochures, catalogs, and multi-page documents

- Sales and promotional collateral

- Create layouts and branded materials that align with company guidelines and visual identity.

- Develop compelling visual concepts from creative briefs through final production.

- Use Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign) to produce professional, production-ready assets.

- Ensure consistency, quality, and attention to detail across all deliverables.


AI-Powered Creative Production

- Utilize AI tools to accelerate and enhance creative workflows across marketing and design projects.

- Generate, refine, and optimize images using AI platforms such as GPT, Nano Banana, Magnific, Midjourney, or similar tools.

- Create AI-assisted visual content for social media campaigns, newsletters, marketing graphics, presentations, layouts, and complete brochures.

- Develop effective prompts and workflows that consistently produce high-quality creative outputs.

- Edit, expand, retouch, and elevate AI-generated content using Photoshop and other professional design tools.

- Stay current on emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve creative efficiency and output quality.

- Collaborate with marketing and leadership teams to implement AI-driven creative solutions that support business objectives.


✨ Requirements: Experience:

- 5+ years of professional experience in graphic design, preferably within an agency, studio, or fast-paced marketing environment.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

- Demonstrated experience using AI tools as part of a professional creative workflow.

- Strong prompt-writing and AI content generation skills.

- Experience designing social media assets, newsletters, presentations, brochures, and marketing collateral.

- Excellent understanding of layout design, typography, branding, and visual storytelling.

- Ability to take projects from concept through final delivery with minimal supervision.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

- Professional proficiency in both Spanish and English (written and verbal).


Nice to Have Skills:

- Experience with AI video generation tools and workflows.

- Motion graphics or animation experience.

- Familiarity with Canva and PowerPoint for business presentations.

- Experience working with international teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Basic copywriting or content creation experience.

✨What Success Looks Like

- Consistently delivering high-quality design work across multiple channels.

- Effectively integrating AI into creative workflows to improve speed, quality, and innovation.

- Producing polished, brand-consistent assets for social media, newsletters, presentations, brochures, and marketing campaigns.

- Bringing fresh creative ideas and AI-driven solutions that enhance the team's overall output and efficiency.


😎 Why Join Us?

This is more than a traditional design role — it's a chance to be part of a forward-thinking creative team that actively embraces innovation and the exciting frontier of AI-powered design. You'll work on diverse, meaningful projects that challenge and grow your skills, surrounded by passionate creatives who value collaboration, originality, and true craft.


How to Apply:

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here's what to expect:


- Complete the application form:

- Screening interview with our recruitment team

- Interview with the client

- Final decision – some candidates may have a second client interview before an offer is made


We're looking forward to learning more about you!

title: Power Electronics PCB Design Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Electronics PCB Design Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Power Electronics PCB Design Expert to design, evaluate, and validate power electronic circuits and PCB layouts. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in power supply design, component selection, PCB layout best practices, and design verification methodologies.


Key Responsibilties

  • Design power electronic circuits including DC-DC converters, LDOs, AC-DC power supplies, and automotive power systems.
  • Create schematics and PCB layouts using tools such as KiCad, Altium, or equivalent.
  • Select components based on electrical, thermal, and reliability requirements.
  • Perform design analysis for efficiency, ripple, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability.
  • Generate manufacturing deliverables including BOMs, Gerber files, and assembly data.
  • Validate designs through simulations, calculations, DRC/LVS checks, and design reviews.
  • Develop and apply verification frameworks for schematic and PCB layout quality, including specification compliance, topology validation, component derating, DFM, thermal integrity, and power integrity.


Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals (DC-DC converters, switching regulators, LDOs, power components) .
  • Hands-on experience with schematic design and PCB layout.
  • Proficiency with PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, or similar) .
  • Ability to interpret datasheets and validate component selection.
  • Knowledge of DRC, manufacturability, grounding, routing, and EMI best practices .


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AC-DC power supply design and automotive electronics.
  • Familiarity with thermal analysis, power integrity, and simulation tools.
  • Experience developing hardware validation or evaluation frameworks.
  • Basic scripting experience (Python/terminal-based verification workflows).


Qualification

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in power electronics and PCB design .


Key Compentencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and design quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
  • Effective communication skills.

title: Remote QA Specialist - Audio Annotation & Diarization (Russian)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote QA Specialist - Audio Annotation & Diarization (Russian) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are building a highly accurate, evaluation-grade dataset of transcribed, multi-channel audio recordings to assess multilingual, multi-speaker AI systems. This project involves evaluating high-quality and realistic conversations representing diverse dynamics, contexts, and demographics.


The Workflow:

Contributors record unscripted group conversations. These recordings are run through an initial transcription and diarization pass, which contributors then human-validate and correct. As a QA Specialist, you are the final line of defense, responsible for reviewing the end-to-end quality of both the audio recordings and the human-verified annotations.


Key Responsibilities

Audio Quality Assurance:

  • Evaluate multi-channel audio recordings to ensure they meet strict technical and fidelity requirements.
  • Verify channel isolation (ensuring no audio bleed) and confirm that recordings were captured in appropriate, quiet environments free from disruptive background noise, clipping, or low gain.


Transcription & Diarization Verification:

  • Review human-validated transcriptions to guarantee exceptionally high accuracy and adherence to strict low error-rate (WER) targets.
  • Confirm that transcripts correctly capture spontaneous, unnormalized speech, preserving natural conversational dynamics such as overlaps, interruptions, and false starts.
  • Validate the precision of turn-level and word-level timestamps, as well as speaker identification, paying special attention to complex, overlapping dialogue , while comfortably reading and validating the underlying JSON-formatted data to ensure accurate metadata tagging and timestamp logic.


Metadata & Content Review:

  • Verify the accuracy of all applied metadata, including demographic markers, contextual domains, and specific conversational tags.
  • Enforce strict safety and privacy standards by auditing sessions to ensure no Personally Identifying Information (PII), toxic, or sensitive content is present.
  • Execution & Reporting:
  • Assess the end-to-end quality of the annotation task, assigning clear pass/fail or agree/disagree statuses during your review.
  • Provide detailed, actionable comments and feedback whenever disagreeing with an annotator's work.


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Exceptional ear for audio fidelity and the ability to detect subtle background noises, channel bleed, or clipping.
  • Meticulous attention to detail for verifying word-level timestamps and strict, unnormalized verbatim transcription rules.
  • Native proficiency in Russian
  • Ability to accurately assess complex multi-speaker dynamics.


Ideal Backgrounds include:

  • Linguists/Phonetics Experts: Deep understanding of natural, unnormalized speech patterns. Expertise in accurately identifying and annotating complex conversational dynamics, including overlaps, false starts, and backchannels.
  • Language Teachers: Exceptional, native-level mastery of the target language. Ability to strictly adhere to verbatim transcription guidelines, documenting every stutter, filler word, and disfluency without applying prescriptive grammar corrections.
  • Professional Transcriptionists: Ear for audio fidelity , rigorous timestamping skills, and experience meeting strict accuracy targets. Rigorous approach to precise turn-level and word-level timestamping.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks


Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.
